class.name: NetwTransaction
class.brief_description: The batch of writes collected inside a [method NetwDatabase.transaction] body.
class.description: A transaction body receives one of these and queues its writes onto it. Nothing is written while the body runs: [method NetwDatabase.transaction] commits the whole batch once the body returns, which is what makes the commit happen exactly once even when the body takes an early exit. [codeblock] await db.transaction( func(tx: NetwTransaction) -> void: tx.queue_upsert(&"rocks", &"rock_1", {&"health": 50}) tx.queue_upsert(&"rocks", &"rock_2", {&"health": 75}) ).wait() [/codeblock]

method.name: queue_upsert
method.description: Enqueues a write of [param data] to [param id] in [param table]. It lands through [method NetwDatabaseBackend.upsert], so a partial [param data] merges into the stored record rather than replacing it. Queueing the same [param id] twice queues two writes, applied in order.
